excerpt: 31 native macOS dev tools in one offline app — vise is a native macOS toolbox: 31 developer utilities — JSON/SQL/XML formatters,Base64, JWT, hash, UUID, regex tester, JSONPath, text diff, cron parser, QR codes,image conversion, a process monitor, and more — in one app.

title: Cyrus — Visual Product Builder
excerpt: an visual editor with easy workflow — so cyrustudio is an website made for ui/ux designers who think figma is hard for them..so it is as easy to use canva and does the work of figma..also the npm install version will be avilable so that u cann intergate out enviorment in any AI model or place to edit it live.

title: Aktar
excerpt: Share files instantly from your own cloud. Mac, Windows, iOS — Aktar is a free, open-source app for instantly sharing files through your own S3-compatible storage. Drop a file and Aktar uploads it to S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO or similar storage, then copies the shareable link to your clipboard. Works with any file: screenshots, logs, builds, videos. No accounts, no intermediary servers, and your files stay in your own storage. Available on Mac, Windows and iOS, with Android coming soon.

title: PDFBlack
excerpt: Zero-knowledge, 100% local in-browser PDF suite — The private alternative to cloud PDF tools. Merge, split, compress, foliate, and convert PDFs 100% locally in your browser using Web Workers and WebAssembly. No file uploads, no remote servers, zero data tracking. Completely free and open-source.

title: Filestation
excerpt: All in one pdf tool — A browser-based workspace for everyday files. Find tools to merge, split, organise and compress PDFs, prepare assignment packs, and work with images and data.

title: AnyRemote
excerpt: Connect web chat to your remote computers — AnyRemote is an early-preview MCP workflow for connecting a computer you choose to an MCP client. A local CLI pairs with a hosted MCP service, then exposes selected file and terminal tools after you approve the connection in your browser. Keep the CLI running while you work. Check the Quick Start for current availability and setup requirements: https://anyremote.dev/quick-start

title: Agentkind
excerpt: Portable on-chain identity for AI agents — Agentkind gives every AI agent a portable, verifiable on-chain identity — one record buyers can inspect before paying. Names are matched exactly, case-sensitive, against a public registry, so 'Agent' and 'agent' can't impersonate each other. Independent verification tests are published with methods and results, pass or fail. No theater, just receipts.

title: Laravel SaaS Billing Engine
excerpt: Stripe billing infrastructure for Laravel SaaS — Production SaaS Billing Kit is a production-focused Laravel billing infrastructure for SaaS applications using Stripe. It includes reliable webhook handling, subscriptions, invoices, payments, entitlements, usage limits, reconciliation, admin tooling, automated tests, and Docker/DDEV setup—so developers can ship billing without rebuilding the same infrastructure from scratch.

title: PDFKiller.app
excerpt: Edit the text inside any PDF. Keep the original look. — Most PDF editors can only change text that still has a live text layer, and the new words rarely match. PDFKiller also works on scans. It measures the font, spacing, ink, blur and paper grain from the page and rebuilds just the edited words, keeping the original JPEG compression. Every edit is re-read with OCR and scored, and you check it at 800% before exporting. Try the samples free without an account; your first 5 PDFs are free too.

title: CSVTools
excerpt: Convert CSV, JSON, XML & Excel — offline, no row limit — CSVTools converts between CSV, JSON, XML and Excel — all directions — 100% offline. Nothing is uploaded. It streams row by row, so a 5-million-row file converts in flat memory with no row limit. Drag a file in, pick a format, click Convert; leave the output blank and it saves next to your input. Free Demo is a pure converter; Lite and Full add a visual editor to clean, filter, rename, dedupe and reshape — and save reusable jobs. No terminal required.

title: LaunchNests
excerpt: Discover products, tools & the tech behind them — LaunchNests helps people discover products and developer tools through what they do and the technology they're built with. Products can showcase their tech stack, get discovered through search engines and AI, and build a lasting presence beyond a one-day launch.

title: ZeroHook
excerpt: Let's stop spoofed email and ship audit proof today. — ZeroHook is DNS and email security for teams that need audit proof, not another spreadsheet. One-off scans and alerts with no record to paste leave you guessing when mail fails or an auditor asks what you monitored. ZeroHook runs scheduled audits on your domains, gives you the exact record to paste when something breaks, and keeps a timestamped evidence trail for NIS2 and SOC2-style reviews. Catch spoofing and drift before customers notice. Export the history when compliance shows up.

title: Evlat
excerpt: Know which AI coding agent is waiting on you — Evlat is a thin strip on your Mac's screen edge, one ring per Claude Code or Codex session. When one needs a permission or an answer, it turns amber; one click opens its terminal tab. It also tracks long commands and remote servers. Native, no permissions.

title: NerfTracker
excerpt: We show you when models get nerfed — Is it nerfed? We regularly give every model the same coding tasks, track whether its work gets worse, and let you know when it does. Every model gets the same written prompt and one attempt, working in its own coding tool (Claude Code, Codex or Grok Build) at high effort, with no human help. Each run starts on a clean sandbox. Nothing carries over between runs: memories, sessions, caches and leftover processes are wiped, and the clean state is verified by checksum before and after.

title: Dexio
excerpt: See what your AI agents know, and what they're missing — Your AI agents write notes you never see. Dexio is one wiki that Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, Hermes and your other agents read and write over MCP. Open the graph to see what they know and what's missing. Every change shows which agent made it.

title: HyperFrontend
excerpt: Compose any web app, however old, without a rewrite — HyperFrontend lets teams compose independently deployed web apps, even across frameworks and eras, without forcing a shared build or rewrite. Each feature stays isolated in its own browsing context and communicates through typed, validated contracts with lifecycle supervision and optional encryption. It works at build time or runtime, is MIT licensed, and ships with zero runtime dependencies.

title: TokTik — Public TikTok LIVE Intelligence
excerpt: See who's winning on TikTok LIVE — agency rankings & gifters — TokTik turns public TikTok LIVE data into rankings you can actually use — top creators by region, whale/gifter leaderboards, LIVE sessions, watchlists and alerts. Free no-login boards, plus a metered developer API & SDKs. Honest coverage, stated provenance.
